what: Hand-tags for path_closure.py (fix 2): paths we treat as cart-legal although OSM does not tag them golf_cart. An active entry writes golf_cart=<value> into OUR extract only, stamped slowgo:golf_cart_override=<id> with the prior value kept in slowgo:golf_cart_orig, never an OSM upload. Read path_closure.py's OVERRIDES section and docs/memos/path-closure-fix2-plan.md before adding one.

rows.where: The Villages: from Glen Hollow Way (28.93459, -81.99593) to the private service roads off 72nd Boulevard (28.93641, -81.99233)
rows.reason: The only open link into a pocket of ~300 address points (72nd Boulevard and 24 private service roads). Fix 2 would close it, because it carries no tags at all, and seal the pocket. Found by the sealed-pocket check on the 2026-10-06 box session (docs/memos/path-closure-fix2-plan.md section 12).
